quests.title: Drowsy Evening Star

dialogue.t: *sigh* Oh, we meet again.
Sorry, but I don't really have time to chat right now.

dialogue.sit: What's wrong?
You seem a little tired.

dialogue.t: Yeah, it's been days since I've had a good night's sleep.
Oh, come to think of it, I haven't seen Twirly-Whirly in a long time...
Ah, but no, now's not the time for that.
I was originally looking up some information at the House of Daena, but the more I read, the more I realized that my thesis is horribly lacking.
Huh...?
What is it? Is there something on my face...?

dialogue.sit: Are you a student here?

dialogue.t: *sigh* I may not be for long.
In a way, I suppose I am... I have no idea what to do about my thesis.
H—Hey, not so loud...!
Ah no, that makes me sound suspicious... Hold on, do I really look that shady?
Anyway, I'm Layla, a Rtawahist student at the Akademiya... for now, at least. I was just looking up some information at the House of Daena...
But the more I read, the more I realized that my thesis lacks integrity. I didn't cover many of the possible outliers, and my calculations aren't precise enough.
I should've been done with the first draft of my thesis by now, but I've barely written a third... *whimper*

dialogue.sit: Okay, so what are you planning to do now?

dialogue.t: Well... *sigh* I guess I have to keep looking up as much info as possible. I shouldn't give up now.
But who am I kidding... Maybe I'm not cut out to be a researcher. Maybe I shouldn't have come to the Akademiya in the first place. All I've done is cause trouble for my adviser and classmates.
I should probably notify my adviser sooner than later, so he can focus his attention on the other students... Ah no, I don't even have the guts to bring it up, and I haven't completely given up yet.

dialogue.sit: Cheer up. Things probably aren't as bad as you think they are.
You still have time, right?

dialogue.t: To be honest, I haven't slept a wink for days... Just thinking about the awful state of my thesis keeps me up at night.
Lack of sleep hinders my ability to focus, and if I can't focus, I can't do any proper research or thinking. I'm stuck in a vicious cycle.
I've seen the caliber of the other Akademiya students, they're all geniuses and fast learners. I'm nowhere near as gifted as they are...
If it wasn't for someone who's been helping me out, my adviser probably would have kicked me out of the Darshan by now.

dialogue.sit: Are they a sage?

dialogue.t: *sigh* No, all my friends are back home. I'm the only one who got to come study at the Akademiya.
If that was the case, I would've already left on my own... Just the idea of being watched by a sage is terrifying.
Huh, what's that? A fungus with a long beard? There's no such thing... though if there were, I'd love to give it a pat or two.
This might sound strange, but I actually don't know who's been helping me. I don't even know if they're a person or not.
Due to my lack of sleep, I sometimes get dizzy and faint when I'm stressed out...

dialogue.sit: It's that bad, huh?

dialogue.t: Yeah... But oddly enough, when I wake up, all the things I was stressing over are taken care of.
My homework's somehow finished before the deadline, and my papers are perfectly written.
But that's not all... my flowers are watered, laundry's done, even my broken Kamera was fixed...
I really don't know what's going on, but for now, I'm calling the phenomenon a "blessing from the stars."
Maybe the stars above decided to help out after seeing all the effort I put into my research... Haha, if that's even possible...

dialogue.sit: That sounds pretty extraordinary.
I want powers like that.

dialogue.t: *sigh* But, there's no point in me studying at the Akademiya if I keep relying on this mysterious phenomenon...
It comes down to my own efforts, improving one step at a time... How else can I honor my parents and live up to the expectations of everyone who knows me.

dialogue.sit: That makes sense. The effort you put in is equally important.

dialogue.t: Oh no, I've already spent too much time chatting...
*sigh* I still haven't made much headway on my thesis. At this rate, I'll need the Wisdom Seelie's help.

dialogue.sit: You just said you wanted to rely on your own efforts...

dialogue.t: Yes, but time's of the essence, so I have to take what I can get... Sorry, I'm just making excuses...
But the Wisdom Seelie is truly amazing and freely shares its endless knowledge.
If you want its help, all you have to do is write down your question, and you'll get a response a short while later.

dialogue.sit: Can Seelie even do something like that?
Maybe it's some researcher who wants to remain anonymous?

dialogue.t: No one knows who or what it actually is... It's just known as the Wisdom Seelie.
But getting an answer all comes down to the Seelie's mood. Sometimes it'll only give you a vague answer or play tricks on you. I'm pretty sure a researcher wouldn't do something like that...
All I can do right now is hope that it helps me...

dialogue.sit: But what about the blessing from the stars?

dialogue.t: Who knows if it'll happen this time... I can't put all my eggs in one basket.
Trying my luck with another phenomenon is better than doing nothing.

dialogue.sit: It's too risky to rely on some fishy legend to complete your thesis.

dialogue.t: Oh, really? But I don't want to take up your time...

dialogue.sit: It's fine, I don't have anything going on.
I'm worried that you'll pass out from exhaustion soon.

dialogue.t: Sorry for the bother. You're too kind.
Okay, let's go give it a try. I've already prepared my question for the Seelie.
I just hope it can help me get through this predicament.
Among the countless legends surrounding the House of Daena, the Wisdom Seelie is one of the more popular ones lately...
It hasn't been around for long, but word of the Seelie's existence spread like wildfire. Many people have claimed that they've received a reply from it.
So it should probably help me as well, right?
I don't know its name, and we have to keep our voices down in the House of Daena, or else you'll get some scary glares from the Mahamata.
Any funny antics in the House of Daena will get you escorted out... or perhaps thrown out.
Let's split up and ask around about the Seelie. Hopefully someone knows something more.
Mmm... You're right. I need to keep a level head — I don't have time to waste.
But what do we do from here...? I can't just go back and start packing to leave.
Rest...? But my deadline's just around the corner. I don't think I can afford to rest right now...

dialogue.sit: You won't be able to write anything in your current state.
You'll waste even more time if you try to push yourself like this.

dialogue.t: ...You do have a point. Sorry, I tend to panic easily... as you can see.
Then how should I rest? I definitely won't be able to sleep... As soon as I close my eyes, all kinds of thoughts start floating into my head.
Oh, that's a good idea. A cup of coffee might help clear my head. Let's go.

dialogue.sit: You should rest first.
How about we head to Puspa Café?

dialogue.t: (Maybe I should just go back...)

quests.description: One day, you walk into the Sumeru Akademiya...

quests.title: The Wisdom Seelie

dialogue.t: Excuse me, have you ever heard of the Wisdom Seelie?
Heh, you've come to the right person.
I came across this legend not too long ago myself. After hearing about it, I decided to test it out and asked it a question about the brightness of the stars.
Two days later, I got a response. It included two pages of detailed and accurate information. It saved me from having to look up a ton of resources.
R—Really?
Yeah, so I submitted another question a few days ago. I still haven't received a reply, though.
That sounds like what others have said. But I don't have the time to wait for a reply if the Seelie doesn't answer right away...
Ahh, whatever. Can you please tell me how to submit a question to the Wisdom Seelie?
It's quite simple. Go to the bookshelf over there and find either "Theoretical Astrology" or "A Quick Reference Guide to Astrology Cases."
Oh, I know where those are... My Darshan has us use those two books quite often.
Okay, so write your question in a letter addressed to the Wisdom Seelie, and then insert the letter into one of the books.
Come back in a day or two, and if you see a red stamp on your letter, that means the Wisdom Seelie has replied.
However, if the stamp never appears, then that means the Seelie doesn't want to answer your question.
I see. Thank you so much.
I'm gonna go write down my question. Hopefully the Seelie replies...

dialogue.section: Head over to the bookshelf Rabah mentioned

dialogue.sit: Layla places her letter in the designated book.

dialogue.t: Whew, finally... I wrote out my question and put it in the book.

dialogue.sit: What do we do now?

dialogue.t: Wait, I guess. Let's give it some time.
I'll come back tomorrow to check on it. Don't worry about me if you have other things to do.

dialogue.sit: I'll come with you. I'm a little worried.

dialogue.t: I see... Thanks, I appreciate it.
Alright then, let's meet up here tomorrow. I really hope the Seelie replies.

dialogue.sit: The next day, you and Layla return to the same bookshelf.

dialogue.t: Time to look at the letter. Please let there be a stamp, please let there be a stamp...
Ah, there's a red stamp on it! The Seelie responded! Fantastic!

dialogue.sit: You look better already.
Your eyes are sparkling.

dialogue.t: This is wonderful. My troubles are at an end! I can't even begin to express how grateful I am.
Let's take a look at what it wrote...
"Thank you for your letter. Though I have extended a response, I cannot answer your query due to your questionable motives."
Questionable motives? ...Me? W—Wait, huh?
Okay, let's see... "Completing a thesis requires independent thought and work. You planned on using my knowledge to complete your paper's most critical portions. That's not right."
"However, considering that your deadline is fast approaching, and that there is substance to the content in the completed sections of your thesis, I've decided to help you nonetheless."
"Follow the hints I've left, and you will find the answer to your question."
"Consider the effort you put into thinking and searching as your payment for my knowledge."
What the...
It's absolutely right about everything... I'm starting to feel guilty now, I can't deny any of it.
But I'm running out of time... Oh, what should I do...?

dialogue.sit: I'll search for the answer with you.
It might be messing with you.

dialogue.t: Huh? Uh...
I could tell you're a very kind person, but I never expected that you'd go this far to help me...
I'll definitely think of a way to make it up to you once I take care of my thesis.

dialogue.sit: Don't worry about it.
Just another day in the life of an adventurer.

dialogue.t: Okay, let's start by looking at the hint it left us. It should be on the second page.
"The first clue lies hidden on the road of wisdom. The headstrong child finally sees the world for how big it truly is, filled with awe, yet struck with fear."
That's it? Not even a picture or any other marking to go off of... This is pretty abstract.
What's this road of wisdom, and who's the child?
Hmm, possibly. That sounds like a natural conclusion. So, is the road of wisdom the road that leads to the Akademiya then?
Wait, I think I get what it means by the "child" and "awe and fear"...
When I first left home, it took me days to reach Sumeru City. I was completely shocked when I first saw it with my own eyes.
It was so grand and awe-inspiring... Pictures of the city simply don't do it any justice.
After seeing the city, a thought popped into my head: "Am I really worthy of this place?"
Worry, fear, or whatever you want to call it. Hmm, if I'm connecting the dots correctly, then I think I know where the Seelie is leading us.
But, how does it know my feelings so well?

dialogue.sit: Maybe it wasn't referring to you specifically.
People who come to Sumeru City from elsewhere might often have similar feelings.

dialogue.t: You have a point. There's nothing special about my background or experiences. It could be anyone's...
Anyway, let's go take a look!

dialogue.sit: "Wisdom" is probably referring to the Akademiya?
And that's the "fear"?

dialogue.t: Hmm, good point. Why else would it use such a roundabout way to tell me its answer?
Supposedly, everyone who's been pranked by the Seelie had angered it in some way...
That means the Seelie is someone who's very strict and serious about knowledge... but who knows if it's really a Seelie or some person.

dialogue.sit: The main issue is that you have a deadline to meet.
There's no guarantee that you'll actually get an answer, even after doing what it says.

dialogue.t: True... And if I don't get an answer, then I'll only have wasted more time.
*sigh* But there's nothing else we can do. It's the one holding all the cards... It's completely hidden and can choose whether to help us or not.
After all, it'd probably be impossible to find it and ask my question in person...
Huh? I was just kidding... Please don't take me seriously.

It's a Seelie we're talking about. According to legend, Seelies are elusive and can create countless copies of themselves... Who's to say that it won't summon a shooting star to crush us once we find it?

dialogue.sit: You don't actually believe in those legends, do you...?
Think about what you just said for a moment.

dialogue.t: S—Sorry... I'm just a little panicky...
Okay, Layla, calm down and think... If the Seelie is a person, then there has to be a way to track them down.
We have two possible leads right now. The first is the checkout logs of those two books, and the other is the red stamp.
The red stamp bears the Rtawahist emblem, which is used by a lot of people. It'll be hard to track down an individual, so we should probably start with the checkout logs.
Let's go and make an inquiry. We can also ask around the House of Daena and see if anyone else knows something about the Wisdom Seelie.

dialogue.sit: Now that sounds like an idea.
Can't disagree with that logic.

dialogue.t: There's no harm in trying. Now let's see if it's in the mood to answer your question.
(She probably won't hear back in time.)

quests.description: Layla mentioned that the Wisdom Seelie could help with her thesis. You feel a little skeptical, but still decide to check it out with her.

quests.title: Taking the Opposite Route

dialogue.section: Gather more information about the Wisdom Seelie

dialogue.t: Oh, hello there. Can I help you?
Uh, hello, I'm a Rtawahist student and would like to see the checkout logs for "Theoretical Astrology" and "A Quick Reference Guide to Astrology Cases."
Oh, are you also here to investigate the Rtawahist Wisdom Seelie legend?
"Also?" Hmm... I suppose it makes sense that we're not the only ones investigating such a popular legend.
Yes, I myself am also quite curious about it. But unfortunately, I haven't found anything out of the ordinary.
Given you're a Rtawahist student, I'm sure you know that a lot of research references these two books. All our copies of these particular titles are frequently checked out.
I have looked into it, but found no irregularities in the checkout logs.
Is there any chance the Seelie could have taken the books out and returned them without being noticed...?
Not likely, that would be almost impossible. The House of Daena is extremely strict about the circulation of its books. There will always be a record if a book is checked out.
And even if it managed to figure out a way to take the books without leaving any record, it's possible that someone would come looking to borrow the books before the Seelie returned them.
If someone discovers that a book is missing or that it doesn't match my inventory records, it would come to my attention immediately.
However, it might be possible to pull off in the case of a less popular book...
Okay. I understand now, thank you.
This is useful to know. With any luck, it'll help us work out the Seelie's identity.

dialogue.section: Gather more information about the Wisdom Seelie

dialogue.t: Hi there, have you heard of the legend of the Wisdom Seelie?
Do I really look like the kind of student that would be interested in such a pointless legend...?
Oh uh, I'm sorry, we were just curious.
Well, I do happen to have some information on it.

dialogue.sit: Then why didn't you just say so?

dialogue.t: Huh? Logically, that has nothing to do with the question I asked.
I just don't want others to see me as some poor excuse for a student, whiling away my time in the House of Daena.
I don't really think bad students would come to the House of Daena to pass the time... But anyways, you were saying?
Well, I spend most of my time here, and I have noticed something odd before.
One time, late at night, a black shadow fell from above and landed in the central area of the House of Daena.
Of course, I was a little sleepy at the time, but it startled me and I got up to see what was going on.
An—And then what happened??
Then, the shadow quickly circled behind me with incredible speed. Just as I tried to turn around to get a look at it, I fainted.

dialogue.sit: This shadow sounds pretty powerful.

dialogue.t: Yes, it was unbelievably fast. I had never seen anything like it. It was so unusual that I wasn't sure if it was real or if I was half-dreaming.
But given how popular the legend of the Seelie has become lately, maybe this has something to do with it.
Don't take this the wrong way, but... doesn't the House of Daena have a door?
It was closed that night. I suppose even the House of Daena needs to be closed for maintenance from time to time.
I see, that makes sense...
But what were you doing here if the House of Daena was closed?
Don't look so surprised. It's a common practice to find a place to hide before they lock the doors so you can continue reading books here... Everyone knows that.

dialogue.sit: Good thing I'm not studying alongside you. I can tell that you'd really stress me out.

dialogue.t: Anyway, thank you for the info. I'll be sure to take note of everything you mentioned.
You're welcome.

dialogue.section: Gather more information about the Wisdom Seelie

dialogue.t: Hi there, do you know anything about the Wisdom Seelie?
Yes, of course. I've been looking into it for quite a while now.
However, I feel like I'm still missing some key pieces of information. Hey, maybe if we put our heads together, we can figure something out.
Sure, I'll try my best.
There are a few known traits of the Wisdom Seelie. First, it's extremely strong. It can easily carry a few dozen books, along with four or five pieces of astrology equipment all at once.
It's extremely athletic as well. It only moves in a straight line and doesn't stop for anything, not even walls or rivers.
Lastly, it has a number of "special abilities." It has a hardened metal body that's impervious to injury, it can freeze water into ice, and it can also summon meteors.
That... doesn't even sound human.

dialogue.sit: It sounds like some hero out of a fairy tale.

dialogue.t: Well, it is a legend after all. It's no surprise that some details seem a little exaggerated.
But these aren't just made up, you know. Each of its abilities has been confirmed by eyewitnesses.
There have been many sightings too, including at Chatrakam Cave, the Avidya Forest, and around the waterfall south of Sumeru City.
Has anyone seen what it actually looks like? Or what kind of a person it is?
Hmm, not that I know of. No one's been able to get close to it. It seems like it tries to stay out of sight.
I would probably want to remain a mystery too, if I were someone as legendary as the Wisdom Seelie.
So, what do you make of it? Have you seen it somewhere as well?
No... We're probably gonna need some time to digest all the... incredible information you've provided us.
Haha, not a problem. But if you manage to find anything, be sure to come and tell me about it.
I trust that you'll quickly discover the excitement of slowly unraveling the truth.
I assure you that you won't find anything strange here.
If you don't have any more questions, I'm gonna go back to my books now.
Please remember to share any new information you come across.
(*sigh* Did someone put the books back in the wrong place again?)
(I wonder if there will be any new sightings today...)
(It's so exciting to search and dig for the truth.)

quests.description: After weighing the pros and cons, you decide to seek out the Wisdom Seelie's true identity.

quests.title: Compiling the Clues

dialogue.section: Go over the clues with Layla

dialogue.t: Okay, everyone's given us a lot of useful information. Let's go through it and try to organize everything.
Some things we heard were pretty straightforward, but others were just ridiculous...

dialogue.sit: We should be able to figure out more about its identity and whereabouts.

dialogue.t: Yeah, let me think and see what I can make of it.
(Okay, calm down Layla. I know the info's all over the place, but you can definitely do it.)
(First, let's try to figure out the Seelie's identity based on the clues we currently have.)
(Then, we'll analyze where it's been sighted and its motives... Finally, we'll piece everything together...)
(From there, we should be able to predict its movement. Alright, let's give it a try.)
Okay, I think I've got it now...

dialogue.sit: So, what've you come up with?

dialogue.t: First, based on the information Katayoun provided, we can assume that the Seelie is a student from the Rtawahist Darshan.
The possibility of it being someone outside the Darshan can be ruled out because it'd be impossible to gain access to those two books without going through the librarian.
Next, leaving its crazy abilities aside, all the sightings took place in locations that are officially recommended for astrology observation by the Akademiya.
In other words, it's probably just conducting research, and the nature of its research is very similar to mine.
The question that I submitted was no simple query, but it was able to give me a reply in just a day. This implies that it's familiar with a similar field of knowledge.
So, based on this reasoning, all we have to do is wait for it at the next astrological observation site.

dialogue.sit: Your reasoning is solid.
Look at you, finishing your thesis should be no problem at all.

dialogue.t: Ah, uh... It's nothing, really. There are actually some other factors that I've been speculating about...
But that's not important right now, let's get going. Even though we have a lead, it's still hard to say whether we'll be able to make any discoveries.
I'll tell you what I mean by that if the Seelie doesn't show up...
The weather today is perfect for observation. Let's see if it shows up.
Honestly, spending an entire night waiting for something that we're not sure is gonna happen might not be the best use of our time...
But we don't really have any choice. This is all we've got.
Get some sleep if you're tired. I'll be up, it's not like I can sleep anyways.

dialogue.sit: I'll stay up with you.
I'm afraid you'll get bored.

dialogue.t: Thanks. Hmm... Oh, how about I share some basics about astrology with you? If you're interested, that is.
Sure enough, it didn't show up.
We hardly saw any animals, let alone people.
No matter how conclusive the evidence is or how perfect our reasoning may be, nothing will happen as long as I'm awake.

dialogue.sit: Are you referring to the... "Wisdom Seelie" or the "blessing from the stars"?

dialogue.t: They're probably one and the same.
It's like I told you — I have a severe sleeping disorder... and there have been a lot of rumors about me sleepwalking.
I tried to understand what I had been doing when I'm unconscious, but I've never been able to get any definitive evidence.
Something is actively attempting to cover up all the clues without my knowing.
Maybe that "something" is me... or maybe it isn't... I can't be sure...
For all I know, I could even BE the Seelie. But... what if I am?
Would "the Seelie" be willing to help me this time? What is it actually thinking? I really have no idea...

dialogue.sit: What if I could help you?

dialogue.t: Huh? You want to help me?
Of course, it would be nice to know what's really going on...
But that's impossible. It's always avoiding me and keeping me in the dark... And that won't change, even if you're around.

dialogue.sit: (Seeing how badly she wants to know, maybe we should find a way to ask the "other Layla" about it...)

dialogue.t: Huh? What's wrong?

dialogue.sit: Oh, nothing. Maybe there really isn't anything we can do.
Seems like we've come up empty-handed again this time.

dialogue.t: Yeah...
*sigh* And to think I could've been working on my thesis this whole time... Ahh, my stomach is churning just thinking about it...

dialogue.sit: You're really not going to finish on time now.
There's nothing else I can do. I'm sorry.

dialogue.t: Please stop... the more you talk about it, the more silly I feel...
Oh, c'mon Layla, what are you doing? Everyone's gonna start thinking you're crazy now...
Ahh... oh no. I'm losing it... So dizzy... ugh...

dialogue.sit: (I'm sorry to have to make you feel so uncomfortable.)

dialogue.t: Hmm... oh, I'm sorry, I got distracted there. Where were we?

dialogue.sit: (It seems like she's completely recovered. Huh, does that mean...)

dialogue.t: Oh, what's wrong? You look like you've got something on your mind.

dialogue.sit: Are you... the other Layla?

dialogue.t: Hmm? What are you talking about? What do you mean the "other" Layla...? I am Layla.

dialogue.sit: But you somehow seem a little different.
Then why don't you repeat the conversation we just had?

dialogue.t: *sigh*
Fine. It appears that you were waiting for me to show up. I suppose there's no use in me pretending.
I promise I don't mean any harm, and I'll answer all your questions. But before that, would you mind telling me who you are first?

dialogue.sit: I'm a friend of Layla's. I'm trying to help her finish her thesis.

dialogue.t: Let me think... Okay, I got it. You two found this place by following the hints that I left behind. You were planning to wait for me... Or, I should say, you were waiting for the Seelie to show up.
Was this your idea or hers?

dialogue.sit: Mostly hers.

dialogue.t: I see. Yes, she's always had great analytical skills. It'd be nice if she was more confident, though.
Alright, that's all the questions I have. Your turn, please ask away.
That's right... Though I didn't intend for it to turn out this way, really. I just wanted to help out a few other classmates who were having a hard time while I was helping Layla finish her thesis.
You see, Layla doesn't have many friends at the Akademiya. If the others noticed her helping them out, I thought maybe I'd help her become more sociable.
Unfortunately, that didn't really work out. Instead, legends of "the Seelie" started going around. Hehe, but that's alright.

dialogue.sit: What's with the Seelie pranking people?
Did you infiltrate the House of Daena? And what about those rumors of special powers?

dialogue.t: I can instantly tell which students are asking serious questions and which are just trying to take advantage of me to slack off.
My time to move freely is quite limited, so it's only natural that I would punish the people attempting to waste my time.
My intention is to help people. I'm not here to cause any harm.

dialogue.sit: Did you infiltrate the House of Daena? And what about those rumors of special powers?

dialogue.t: Infiltrating the House of Daena was a total accident. She'd forgotten an important book, and the House of Daena happened to be closed at the time. There were only days before the paper was due.
I had no choice but to scale the walls with some simple climbing ropes and sneak in from above while the Corps of Thirty wasn't paying attention.
I had no idea there was still a student inside. I had no choice but to put him to sleep.
Any clear evidence of my existence would only hinder my ability to conceal my identity. It would also expose me to Layla as well.
As for the special powers... Well, they're just things I did during the process of trying to finish the thesis. It's like I said — I don't have much time, so I need to be as efficient as possible.

Unfortunately, that didn't really work out. Instead, legends of "the Seelie" started going around. Hehe, but that's alright.
Infiltrating the House of Daena was a total accident. She'd forgotten an important book, and the House of Daena happened to be closed at the time. There were only days before the paper was due.
I had no choice but to scale the walls with some simple climbing ropes and sneak in from above while the Corps of Thirty wasn't paying attention.
I had no idea there was still a student inside. I had no choice but to put him to sleep.
Any clear evidence of my existence would only hinder my ability to conceal my identity. It would also expose me to Layla as well.
As for the special powers... Well, they're just things I did during the process of trying to finish the thesis. It's like I said — I don't have much time, so I need to be as efficient as possible.

My time to move freely is quite limited, so it's only natural that I would punish the people attempting to waste my time.
My intention is to help people. I'm not here to cause any harm.
